content:
sam: Hi all, new hire question — my first PR landed and reviewers left a couple of small style nits. Quick: what's the canonical branching naming convention and any tips for small doc/code cleanup PRs?

ana: Welcome! Short answer: feature branches use `feat/<JIRA>-short-desc` (e.g., feat/ENG-1024-redis-cache). For tiny fixes/docs you can use `chore/<short>` or `fix/docs-<name>`; just make it obvious in the PR title.

sam: Thanks. The reviewers also suggested moving a tiny helper function into a `utils` module. Is that encouraged?

chris: We prefer keeping helpers package-local unless they're shared across >1 package. For Python, prefer `_helpers.py` in the same package; for Go, put helpers in the same package and only extract to `pkg/<area>/utils` if multiple consumers need it.

sam: Got it. Any linting rules I should run before pushing? CI failed me on ordering of imports and a black formatting mismatch.

infra-bot: Heads up: repo enforces `black` + `isort` for py, `gofmt` for go. Run `make fmt` and `make check` locally. CI will run pre-merge checks too.

ana: Also check `pre-commit` hooks — we have a fair number of auto-fixes. If you run `git commit` they'll auto-run and help catch styling issues.

sam: Re: merging strategy. Should I rebase or merge `main` into my branch? I see both patterns in history.

chris: Prefer rebasing for a cleaner history on most small PRs. If the change is large and you want a merge commit to mark the integration, ask a reviewer. We also squash merges for tiny fixes.

sam: Nice. The reviewer asked for a brief test addition. I can add one but it's a little contrived. Is it ok to add a small unit test for a helper-only change?

chris: Yes, add a unit test when you change behavior or logic. For pure formatting/docs no test required. Keep tests focused and fast.

sam: One more: PR template asked me to link to the design doc if there's behavior change; my change is just refactor. Should I still add a short rationale?

ana: Always add a short rationale in the PR body: what, why, and risk. Even 1-2 lines helps reviewers. If it's a refactor include before/after behavior note.

sam: Thanks! Any watchers or labels I should add?

chris: Add `team:eng-runtime` or `area:infra` as appropriate and `size:XS` for tiny fixes. If you want a quick pre-review ping `@chris` or `@ana` in the thread.

sam: Awesome. I ran `make fmt`, fixed imports, added a tiny test, rebased onto main and pushed a squashed commit. Marked the PR with labels you suggested.

leo: If you want final eyes, send link and I'll glance for ergonomics and any runtime risks.

sam: Will do, sending now. Appreciate the help — this made my first PR much smoother :relaxed:

infra-bot: Reminder: New contributors, please confirm you read CONTRIBUTING.md and passed pre-commit checks. See .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md for the checklist.
